sloka: एवमुक्ता मया सा तु सुरसा कामरूपिणी ।अब्रवीन्नातिवर्तेत कश्चिदेष वरो मम ।। ५.५८.२८ ।।।।
transliteration: evamuktā mayā sā tu surasā kāmarūpiṇī ।abravīnnātivarteta kaścideṣa varo mama ।। 5.58.28 ।।।।

translations.english: "When Surasa said this I who was ten yojanas in height increased by fifteen yojanas.
